newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF MEN'S WORLD SHOT PUT CHAMPION BAGACH.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF MEN'S WORLD SHOT PUT CHAMPION BAGACH.

text.p: Profile of Aleksandr Bagach, who won the world men's shot put title on Saturday:
Banned for two years for excessive testoterone levels in 1989 when he finished third in the European Cup.
In 1993 he took bronze at the Stuttgart world championships, moving up to third place after American Mike Stulce was disqualified for doping.
The following year, he became the first athlete representing Ukraine to win a European indoor title.
In May this year, he improved his best mark with an effort of 21.47 metres. He equalled that mark on Saturday.
